about: The `report_anomalies` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is fy 2024 only.

rows.detail: Two other tables are promised in prose and then absent, exactly as in FY2023: the Finance Committee writes 'The table above outlines the changes in taxes' (page 53) with no table on the page, and the Capital Planning Report writes 'Below is the FY 2025 Capital Plan being recommended for approval' (page 87) followed straight by the committee membership.

rows.table: Town meeting article record with vote tallies
rows.detail: Article 2 this year explicitly says the revolving fund limits are 'as printed in the Annual Town Meeting warrant' rather than reproducing them — FY2023 promised a table and printed nothing.

rows.table: FY2025 voted operating budget by line number
rows.detail: It begins at line 32/Town Clerk's Administration and ends at 'Total Assistance' — so lines 1-31 (debt service, insurance, retirement, general government) AND lines 79 onward (School Department, Monty Tech assessment, transfers to stabilization) are absent from the text layer.

rows.table: State election results and statewide ballot questions
rows.detail: One precinct column header is missing from the header row (the C column), and several cells did not OCR, so column alignment must be checked against the row totals before use.

Pages 21 and 28 are the SAME table printed twice — 'Combining Balance Sheet - Enterprise Funds', identical figures. The table of contents says page 21 is the 'Balance Sheet for FY Ending June 30, 2024', so the town-wide combined balance sheet appears to have been dropped and the enterprise sheet duplicated in its slot.

The dispatch district tables on pages 84-85 are reprinted from FY2023 unchanged — five-year columns still ending at 2023, and the prose beneath still says 'In 2023, NVRDD handled over 76,982 phone calls'. FY2023's monthly business-call table was dropped entirely.
NOTE a probable duplication: the heading 'INSPECTOR OF PLUMBING/GAS / Gary Williams' appears at the top of BOTH page 13 and page 15.

rows.table: Town office hours and phone directory
rows.detail: Almost identical to FY2023 page 198, including the same caveat line and the same lost department labels — the two pages appear to be the same artwork reused.

rows.table: Regional dispatch 911 call volumes, five years
rows.detail: The FY2024 report reprints last year's dispatch figures unchanged, and the narrative under it still reads 'In 2023, NVRDD handled over 76,982 phone calls'.

rows.table: Regional dispatch calls by member town
rows.detail: Also reprinted unchanged from FY2023 page 104 and still ending at 2023.

THERE IS NO GENERAL FUND REVENUE OR RECEIPTS TABLE IN THE FY2024 REPORT, and no general fund appropriations schedule either. FY2023 had both (its 'FY 2023 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2023' on page 25 and its 'GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS' on pages 27-33). The FY2024 accountant's section is a different set of MUNIS-generated, '(Unaudited)' schedules and the table of contents confirms the omission — it lists seven accountant schedules and none of them is a revenue or an appropriations statement. The nearest FY2024 gets to a town-wide revenue figure is one line on page 30: 'Current Year Revenue Closeouts 47,116,149.83' (against 'Current Year Expenditure Closeouts 46,463,708.05').
Page 35 is headed 'FISCAL YEAR 2022 SUMMARY' while every one of its columns is labelled FY2024 and its figures are FY2024.
Page 34 footers 'Page 2 of 2' — page 1 of the trust fund summary is not in the report. (FY2023 did something similar in reverse, printing pages 2, 3 and 4 of a nine-page schedule.)
The middle school MCAS table (page 109) lost the year from its heading, and the paragraph explaining it still refers to '2022 Spring MCAS testing' and 'what 2023 scores will indicate'.
Page 32 contains nothing but the line 'FY2025 LA4/Assessment Clarification—Town of Lunenburg' and a signature block — the assessed-valuation table it names does not appear in the text layer at all.

Things FY2023 had and FY2024 dropped: the building department's permits-issued table, the school enrolment-by-grade table, the PEG access expenses-by-line-item table, and the town-wide receipts and appropriations schedules. Things FY2024 has and FY2023 does not: a named list of every 2024 cemetery interment (page 43), a Senior Property Tax Work-Off report (page 66), ten pages of state and national election results (pages 175-184), the out-of-district special education placement counts (page 97), and turnout figures on the town election tally.

The special education section (page 97) publishes exactly what the standing questions ask for and almost nobody prints: 8 students placed outside the district, split 4 collaborative / 3 day / 1 residential, with the prior year (7) alongside.

The FY2025 school budget supplement of $948,136 was voted at town meeting contingent on a Proposition 2½ ballot question (Article 8, page 144), and the override then appears as 'QUESTION 1. OVERRIDE' on the election tally (page 174), passing 753 to 664.
Two rows have negative balances offset by BANs (FY19 CAPITAL PLAN (96,099.00);

The footer says 'Page 2 of 2' — PAGE 1 OF THIS TWO-PAGE SCHEDULE IS NOT IN THE REPORT. (FY2023 had the same problem in a different shape: it printed pages 2, 3 and 4 of a nine-page schedule.) Fund families identifiable: GENERAL FUNDS, STABILIZATION FUNDS, MISCELLANEOUS FUNDS, PEG ACCESS ENTERPRISE FUND, plus named scholarships.

The receivables schedule on pages 38-39 is headed 'FY2021 COLLECTION OF TAXES' beneath a JUNE 30, 2024 date line. FY2023's copy of the same schedule carries the identical stale label, so this is the form's own text, not an OCR artefact — the label has been wrong for at least two years running.

rows.table: Receivables and collection of taxes summary
rows.detail: The heading 'FY2021 COLLECTION OF TAXES' is printed on both pages under a JUNE 30, 2024 date line — the identical stale label appears in FY2023's copy of this schedule, confirming it is the form's own text and not an OCR error.

Pages 107 and 108 are two DIFFERENT Turkey Hill Elementary staff rosters printed back to back, with different principals, assistant principals and nurses, and nothing on either page says which school year it is.

PAGES 107 AND 108 ARE TWO DIFFERENT TURKEY HILL ROSTERS PRINTED BACK TO BACK with the same section headings and different people in every leadership role — p107 has Norman Yvon as Principal, Bethann Cormier Assistant Principal, Elizabeth Schatia Nurse; p108 has Heidi Champagne, John Palumbo and Meghan Marrone.
They appear to be two different school years and the report does not say which is which.

rows.table: Middle school MCAS results vs state
rows.detail: The figures differ from FY2023's table, so they are not the same data, but nothing on the page reliably states which year they are.

rows.table: Monty Tech financial report, three years
rows.detail: The narrative states the FY24 budget exceeded the Chapter 70 minimum by '$150,000 or 0.05%' — the percentage and the dollar figure are inconsistent with each other.

rows.table: Trust and stabilization funds held by other banks
rows.detail: THE HEADING CONTRADICTS THE COLUMNS: it says 'FISCAL YEAR 2022 SUMMARY' while every column is labelled FY2024 and the figures are FY2024.
Cleaner text layer than FY2023 (all 'plain' extraction, no OCR).

'Barre' is spelled correctly this year (FY2023 OCR'd it as 'Baire'). 2023-2024 enrolment 1,428 (was 1,394); gender split Male 668/47%, Female 745/52%, Non-Binary 14/1% — note the male and female shares SWAPPED relative to FY2023 (700 male / 679 female), which is worth checking against the source before quoting either.

rows.detail: Several amounts are OCR-damaged ('28,500.000', '1, 000.00', a stray '5' or '5057' in the dollar column).
Turnout in the Libertarian primary was in single digits, so many cells are blank and OCR fills some with junk ('-ONM', '.-°').

rows.detail: OCR reads some zeros as letters ('0.0U', 'U.UU', 'U.OU').
Only seven rows carry data and three of them lost their Account Name in OCR.
OCR sprays 'un us es es es' where a column of dollar signs was.
OCR mangles several fund names ('FYZO CAPHIALPLAN', 'rYZI CAPIIAL PLAN', 'ACOUSTION OF STRFFTLGHTS', '30 SCHOOLS DEMOLION/DESIGN').

Most of the Fund Balance column is blank in the OCR even though the rows exist — only the first ~20 rows carry visible amounts, so the schedule is largely unreadable as text despite being cleanly laid out.
One stray OCR artefact in the dollar column ('tA tA tA 92,636.63').

rows.table: Receivables and collection of taxes summary
rows.detail: DRAMATICALLY BETTER than FY2023's version of the same schedule: FY2023 printed it rotated across three pages and OCR destroyed it; here it is upright, two pages, and rows and columns line up.
Same shape as FY2023 page 94 but OCR'd this year rather than laid out, so slightly worse.
OCR quality poor across the whole police insert (79-85), as in FY2023.
